description.zh: QoS策略描述，长度为1~512个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_)或短划线（-）。
description.en: The description of the QoS policy. The description must be 1 to 512 characters in length, and can contain digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or Chinese character.
